title.narrative: Support the National Strategic Plans for Ending TB and On Fast-Track to Ending AIDS - Bhutan (01-Jul-2024-30-Jun-2027)

description.narrative: Bhutan, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of the Royal Government of Bhutan (MOH)This program has the following goals: To achieve 95-100-95 targets for HIV response by 2030, hepatities B and C incidence and mortality elimination targets by 2030 and stregthen interventions for STIs towards diagnosis and informed treatment for elimination of STIs as a public health problem by 2030.. To reduce TB and DR-TB burden until it no longer poses a public health problem. The objectives of this program are: To maximize coverage of comprehensive package of HIV prevention services, with the focus on key populations.. To reduce new infections leading to 90% reduction by 2030 from 2024.. To achieve 95% test and treat targets by 2030 and retain 90% PLHIV on treatment, resulting in undetectable viral load.. To eliminate new HIV, syphilis and hepatitis B infections among children by 2030.. To enhance strategic information to support the validation of the emilination of HIV, hepatitis B and C by 2030.. To build sustainable and cost effective systems for across the health sector with full integration of HIV, viral hepatitis and STIs service.. To reduce TB death rate by 50% between 2024 and 2028.. To increase the proportion of children notified out of the total number above 5% from 2026 onwards.. To reduce RR/MDR-TB incidence by 10% from 2027 onwards.. To impact the TB epidemic in Bhutan by increasing the number of individuals with TB infection undergoing TPT of 50% per year between 2024 and 2028. To assess in detail the existing gap between the estimated incidence and notified cases by 2026
